title: ailocalpack registry index
description: index.json published to GitHub Pages: every pack of the registry, by game and language, with the community numbers aggregated by the registry's Actions. Built by `ailocalpack index build`. The app browses from this file alone and fetches a pack's manifest only when it is needed. Unknown properties are allowed (forward compatibility); a breaking change raises schemaVersion.

generated.description: When the index was built (RFC 3339 with offset).

games.description: Game ID (steam:<app id> or fp:<SHA-256 fingerprint>) → its packs and flags.

optOut.description: The publisher asked not to distribute fan translations: install and generation are blocked.

antiCheatAllowed.description: The game has an anti-cheat but officially allows mods: not blocked.

packs.description: Language tag → packs into that language.

id.description: Pack ID, unique for the game + language.

author.description: The original author (the manifest's first author).

buildIds.description: Store build IDs the pack supports (empty for a manually added game, matched by file hashes).

buildCount.description: How many game builds the manifest lists.

manifest.description: The pack's manifest.json, relative to index.json ('/' separators, no '.' or '..' parts).

size.description: Download size in bytes (string table or binary patch).

rating.description: Aggregated from the pack's GitHub Discussion; absent = nothing yet.

works.description: Players (not the author) who confirmed it works.
